content: {"like":["Enjoys engaging, fast‑paced thrillers with strong moral lessons and unexpected twists.","Appreciates powerful performances, especially from actors like Billy Bob Thornton, Bill Paxton, Robert DeNiro, Michelle Pfeiffer, and Will Anett.","Loves humor that stays fresh, with great comedic timing and memorable facial expressions.","Prefers authentic, real‑life stories that showcase survival, dignity, and self‑integrity.","Enjoys period pieces set in the 1950s–1960s, featuring iconic settings, beautiful women, and memorable cultural moments."],"dislike":["Dislikes movies that are boring, slow, or feel like watching paint dry.","Avoids remakes that waste time and money or fail to surpass the original.","Rejects low‑quality, waste‑of‑time films with no substance or disappointing endings.","Dislikes confusing or gruesome content that detracts from the story.","Prefers not to watch movies that portray parents as sociopaths or that are hard to watch."]}
